Kaspa’s BlockDAG Solution
Instead of adding blocks sequentially, Kaspa uses a BlockDAG structure where multiple blocks can coexist and be processed simultaneously. Imagine multiple highways instead of just one—this means no traffic jams! 🚗💨

Security Without Compromise
Kaspa’s BlockDAG uses the GHOSTDAG protocol, which ensures all blocks are fully validated and secure, even in a high-speed, multi-block environment. It’s like having both speed and safety on the same highway. 🔒

Lower Fees, Greater Accessibility
By reducing congestion and increasing throughput, Kaspa offers consistently low fees. This makes it ideal for microtransactions, remittances, and everyday blockchain use cases. 💸
